confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied context only; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary by neighborhood, booking lead time and July holiday demand. Values assume a COP/USD rate near recent-year levels, so a large peso move would shift the USD figures. Cocktail and wine_glass have weak direct knowledge and are set from the beer anchor (cocktail roughly 2.75 times and wine_glass roughly 2.5 times draught beer). The fx observation is the RBA figure reported in search results for the RBA exchange-rates page; that page was not separately opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator city. Regional basis: Colombian capital-city pricing, reasoned against Latin American capitals with similar tourism profiles (for example Medellin, Quito and Lima) for restaurant and lodging tiers, with drink prices tied to the local beer price.
